page_title: CAG 0-1 JUV | Cagliari v Juventus 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+6' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
90+5' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile was alert and the score remained the same.

90+2' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A lofted cross from Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

89' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 2:5. Total attempts – 7:11.
86' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Antoine Makoumbou walks off.

83' Florinel Coman (Cagliari) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
82' Thiago Motta is forced to make a change. Douglas Luiz is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
81' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Timothy Weah (Juventus). Cagliari are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
81' The game is interrupted as Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is flagged offside.
78' PENALTY APPEAL after Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
77' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
77' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) replaces Manuel Locatelli.
73' Andrea Cambiaso goes off the pitch and Jonas Rouhi (Juventus) comes on.
72' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
72' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
70' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Razvan Marin (Cagliari) replacing Nadir Zortea.
70' Substitution. Michel Adopo makes his way off the pitch and Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
69' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
68' Nice passing game by Cagliari. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
67' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' The game has come to an end for Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Randal Kolo Muani.
62' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
61' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
61' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Deiola leaves the pitch and Florinel Coman (Cagliari) comes on.
57' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Andrea Colombo who sees an offensive foul.
54' None of the Cagliari players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
54' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' A player from Cagliari commits a rough challenge. Andrea Colombo blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
51' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
50' The whistle blows and Timothy Weah (Juventus) is booked for an infringement.

47' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Juventus.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Davide Nicola gives a chance to Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) and Mattia Felici is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
40' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
40' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nadir Zortea (Cagliari).
38' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
36' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece. Juventus win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

29' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
27' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' The Cagliari players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.

24' A loose ball is pounced on by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile is alert and makes a comfortable save.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.

22' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Elia Caprile, who tips the ball around the post.
21' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
20' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cagliari.
12' 0 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
11' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
9' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.

7' Federico Gatti (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
7' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Juventus have a corner.
5' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
4' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
